programmes.d: Two con artists (James Mason, Gina Lollobrigida) bring an outlaw (Lee Van Cleef) into their scheme to bilk the Mexican government out of $1 million.
An unlucky thief makes a friend in prison and from there goes hunting for buried gold.
A gunfighter reconciles with his estranged mother to protect her from greedy land-grabbers.
Don Jose (Franco Nero), a Spanish soldier, meets the beautiful Carmen (Tina Aumont) and instantly becomes obsessed with her.
The son of a Mexican bandit finds a village that is controlled by a former Confederate officer who steals from the locals.
During a local screening of a film, a patron is hit by an unexpected bullet, leaving the police to sift through a cinema full of potential culprits.
After the accidental death of a human during battle, Ultraman takes on the man's appearance and place at the S-Class Species Suppression Protocol to protect Earth from further threats.
An innkeeper (Jeff Daniels) and his daughter (Ariana Richards) wonder why historical-disaster witnesses from the future are in Ohio.
A hooded figure forces a young diva (Cristina Marsillach) to watch as he murders performers in a production of Verdi's opera "Macbeth."

programmes.t: The Bird With the Crystal Plumage
programmes.d: An American writer (Tony Musante) hunts for an elusive slasher after witnessing an attempted murder through the glass doors of a Rome art gallery.
Simone Scafidi examines the life and career of horror filmmaker Lucio Fulci.
A ravenous prehistoric predator is released from underground by an earthquake to terrorize people on land.

A boy, Danny, befriends a rat named Ben and forms an army of his rodent friends in the city drains. Under Ben's orders, the killer rats sweep through the city. The victims are numerous, the stores are devastated, and the population is terrorized.
Gangsters and a vengeful husband (Kenji Isomura) pursue a Japanese bride (Yûki Kudô) and her newly found Australian lover (Russell Crowe).
